description: Use this to see the durable event consumers on this account. Read-only; requires auth and message_read. No inputs. Returns {object:"list", data:[{object:"event_consumer", id, client_id, inbox_id, types, cursor, created_at, updated_at, last_polled_at, last_committed_at}]}. An inbox-scoped key sees only consumers pinned to its inbox. Another account's consumers are not listed.
name: cooper_list_event_consumers

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

last_committed_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the last commit, or null.

last_polled_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the last poll, or null.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object last changed.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: List durable event consumers
